rows.quote: TSMC maintained its lead with 2Q26 revenue nearing $40.2 billion, a 12.1% increase QoQ, capturing a 72.5% market share.
Samsung's market share declined to 5.9% as competitors grew at a faster pace.
SMIC ranked third, with revenue surging 20% QoQ to more than $3 billion. Its market share edged up to 5.4%, narrowing the gap with Samsung.
UMC maintained fourth place with a 3.9% market share.
